newsitem.title: UK: EIB adds 300 bln lire to Feb 2007 step-down bond.
newsitem.headline: EIB adds 300 bln lire to Feb 2007 step-down bond.

text.p: The European Investment Bank has increased its redenominatable bond to 1.8 trillion lire from 1.5 trillion lire, joint lead managers Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Credito Italiano and Paribas said on Tuesday.
The deal will carry a 9.00 percent coupon which will step down unconditionally to 5.75 percent from February 1999. It is redenominatable into euros after EMU.
The new tranche has an issue price of 103.42.
